questions.text: John moved to London 10 years ago and he __________ lives there.
questions.explication: 'Still' exprime une action qui continue jusqu'à maintenant.

questions.text: Julie ____________ walks to school.
questions.explication: 'Always' exprime une habitude régulière.

questions.text: Do you mind ____ it with you?
questions.explication: 'Do you mind' est toujours suivi d'un gérondif (verbe en -ing).

questions.text: Water ____ at 100° C.
questions.explication: Vérité scientifique générale : present simple.

questions.text: I won't be able to do it ____ you help me.

choices.d: if and unless could be used here

questions.explication: 'Unless' = 'sauf si / à moins que' : je ne pourrai pas le faire à moins que tu m'aides.

questions.text: I don't want to go out ____ it's raining - I hate getting wet.

choices.d: if and unless could be used here

questions.explication: Le sens (détester être mouillé) impose 'if' : je ne veux pas sortir s'il pleut.

questions.text: What ____ do if you were in my position?
questions.explication: Second conditionnel (if + prétérit, would + base verbale).

questions.text: You'll be very ill ____ smoking.
questions.explication: 'Si tu n'arrêtes pas de fumer, tu seras malade.'

questions.text: That ____ be true- she would never say something like that.
questions.explication: 'Can't be true' exprime une impossibilité logique forte.

questions.text: Do you think you ____ open the door for me?
questions.explication: 'Could' pour une demande polie.

questions.text: I ____ my grandmother as she died before I was born.
questions.explication: Action liée à un moment précis du passé (avant ma naissance) : prétérit simple.

questions.text: She ____ away for the last two weeks.
questions.explication: 'For the last two weeks' impose le present perfect.

questions.text: She told me she ____ it ages ago.

choices.d: did and had done could be used here

questions.explication: Dans le discours indirect avec un repère temporel précis ('ages ago'), le prétérit et le plus-que-parfait sont tous les deux acceptables.

questions.text: The man ____ answered the phone was rather rude.
questions.explication: Pronom relatif sujet référant à une personne : 'that' (ou 'who') convient ; 'that' est l'option proposée ici.

questions.text: Two guys, ____ car had broken down, asked me for a lift.
questions.explication: 'Whose' exprime la possession (la voiture DES deux gars).

questions.text: She was promoted ____ manager.
questions.explication: 'Promoted to' + poste.

questions.text: If you have any problems, don't worry; I ____ help you.
questions.explication: Décision spontanée / promesse au moment de parler : 'will'.

questions.text: She often goes out ___ Friday night.
questions.explication: 'On' + jour de la semaine.

questions.text: The party is ____ next week.
questions.explication: Avec 'next week', aucune préposition n'est utilisée.

questions.text: He hasn't worked ____ he lost his job.
questions.explication: 'Since' + point de départ dans le temps (évènement).
